title: Barre: Empowering Simplified and Versatile Programmable Congestion Control in High-Speed AI Clusters
problem: Network congestion in high-speed AI clusters severely limits collective communication throughput during distributed training and inference, requiring complex, inflexible congestion control policies tailored to specific cluster configurations.
motivation: As AI clusters scale to thousands of GPUs, congestion control becomes critical for achieving near-ideal network utilization and preventing training bottlenecks that waste expensive compute resources.
method: Barre simplifies congestion control policy writing by providing higher-level building blocks instead of requiring deep networking expertise. Users compose these blocks to create policies tailored to their specific cluster. The policies run either within network switches (in-network) or on end systems like GPUs and network cards (end-host).
key_novelty: Barre lets you quickly develop and deploy custom congestion-control strategies across different hardware vendors without modifying switch or NIC firmware.
contributions: Programmable abstraction for expressing diverse congestion control policies
Simplified implementation reducing barriers to custom network optimization
Versatile policy system supporting workload-adaptive congestion management
Evaluation demonstrating improved cluster throughput on AI training workloads
primary_theme: programmable network congestion control for AI
